zh: 必须；应该；欠（债）；职责；义务

qs.s: ___ partir tôt ce matin.
qs.en: I have to leave early this morning.

qs.s: ___ rendre ce livre à la bibliothèque aujourd'hui.
qs.en: I have to return this book to the library today.

qs.s: ___ finir tes devoirs avant de sortir.
qs.en: You have to finish your homework before going out.

qs.s: ___ appeler ta mère ce soir.
qs.en: You have to call your mother tonight.

qs.s: ___ travailler tard ce soir.
qs.en: He has to work late tonight.

qs.s: ___ prendre ce médicament trois fois par jour.
qs.en: He has to take this medication three times a day.

qs.s: ___ partir dans dix minutes.
qs.en: We have to leave in ten minutes.

qs.s: ___ préparer le rapport pour la réunion.
qs.en: We have to prepare the report for the meeting.

qs.s: ___ remettre le dossier avant vendredi.
qs.en: You have to submit the file before Friday.

qs.s: ___ respecter les règles du bureau.
qs.en: You have to respect the office rules.

qs.s: ___ rentrer avant minuit.
qs.en: They have to be back before midnight.

qs.s: ___ passer un examen demain matin.
qs.en: They have to take an exam tomorrow morning.

qs.s: ___ annuler mon rendez-vous hier.
qs.en: I had to cancel my appointment yesterday.

qs.s: ___ attendre deux heures avant d'être reçu.
qs.en: I had to wait two hours before being seen.

qs.s: ___ recommencer tout depuis le début.
qs.en: You had to start all over again from the beginning.

qs.s: ___ partir sans dire au revoir.
qs.en: You had to leave without saying goodbye.

qs.s: ___ changer ses plans au dernier moment.
qs.en: He had to change his plans at the last moment.

qs.s: ___ travailler le week-end pour finir le projet.
qs.en: He had to work on the weekend to finish the project.

qs.s: ___ prendre un taxi parce que le métro était en panne.
qs.en: We had to take a taxi because the subway was out of service.

qs.s: ___ reporter la réunion à la semaine prochaine.
qs.en: We had to postpone the meeting to next week.

qs.s: ___ attendre longtemps avant d'obtenir une réponse.
qs.en: You had to wait a long time before getting an answer.

qs.s: ___ payer une amende parce que vous étiez en retard.
qs.en: You had to pay a fine because you were late.

qs.s: ___ rentrer tôt à cause de la tempête.
qs.en: They had to return home early because of the storm.

qs.s: ___ renoncer à leur voyage à cause d'un problème de visa.
qs.en: They had to give up their trip because of a visa problem.

qs.s: Quand j'étais enfant, ___ me coucher à neuf heures.
qs.en: When I was a child, I had to go to bed at nine o'clock.

qs.s: À cette époque-là, ___ me lever à six heures chaque matin.
qs.en: At that time, I had to get up at six o'clock every morning.

qs.s: Avant, ___ prendre le bus pour aller à l'école.
qs.en: Before, you had to take the bus to go to school.

qs.s: Dans cet emploi, ___ porter un uniforme tous les jours.
qs.en: In that job, you had to wear a uniform every day.

qs.s: Il ___ rembourser ses dettes chaque mois.
qs.en: He had to repay his debts every month.

qs.s: À l'époque, il ___ voyager souvent pour son travail.
qs.en: At the time, he had to travel often for work.

qs.s: Quand nous étions étudiants, ___ partager un petit appartement.
qs.en: When we were students, we had to share a small apartment.

qs.s: Dans notre ancien travail, ___ faire des heures supplémentaires régulièrement.
qs.en: In our old job, we had to do overtime regularly.

qs.s: Dans votre ancienne école, ___ porter un uniforme.
qs.en: In your old school, you had to wear a uniform.

qs.s: À cette époque, ___ soumettre vos rapports chaque semaine.
qs.en: At that time, you had to submit your reports every week.

qs.s: Autrefois, ils ___ marcher longtemps pour aller chercher de l'eau.
qs.en: In the old days, they had to walk a long way to fetch water.

qs.s: Quand ils habitaient à la campagne, ils ___ conduire une heure pour faire leurs courses.
qs.en: When they lived in the countryside, they had to drive an hour to do their shopping.

qs.s: L'année prochaine, ___ passer mon permis de conduire.
qs.en: Next year, I will have to take my driving test.

qs.s: Si la situation ne s'améliore pas, ___ chercher un autre emploi.
qs.en: If the situation does not improve, I will have to look for another job.

qs.s: Demain, ___ te lever très tôt pour attraper le train.
qs.en: Tomorrow, you will have to get up very early to catch the train.

qs.s: Pour réussir cet examen, ___ étudier davantage.
qs.en: To pass this exam, you will have to study more.

qs.s: Il ___ rembourser son prêt dans les cinq prochaines années.
qs.en: He will have to repay his loan within the next five years.

qs.s: S'il veut progresser, il ___ beaucoup s'entraîner.
qs.en: If he wants to improve, he will have to train a lot.

qs.s: ___ partir avant l'aube pour éviter les embouteillages.
qs.en: We will have to leave before dawn to avoid traffic jams.

qs.s: Si nous voulons finir à temps, ___ travailler ce week-end.
qs.en: If we want to finish on time, we will have to work this weekend.

qs.s: ___ présenter votre passeport à la douane.
qs.en: You will have to present your passport at customs.

qs.s: Pour ce poste, ___ parler couramment anglais et espagnol.
qs.en: For this position, you will have to speak English and Spanish fluently.

qs.s: Ils ___ quitter l'appartement avant la fin du mois.
qs.en: They will have to leave the apartment before the end of the month.

qs.s: S'ils veulent voyager à l'étranger, ils ___ renouveler leurs passeports.
qs.en: If they want to travel abroad, they will have to renew their passports.

qs.s: À ta place, ___ accepter cette offre d'emploi.
qs.en: In your place, I should accept this job offer.

qs.s: ___ m'excuser auprès de lui, mais je ne sais pas comment commencer.
qs.en: I should apologize to him, but I don't know how to start.

qs.s: ___ te reposer un peu, tu as l'air épuisé.
qs.en: You should rest a little, you look exhausted.

qs.s: ___ manger plus de légumes pour rester en bonne santé.
qs.en: You should eat more vegetables to stay healthy.

qs.s: Il ___ consulter un médecin pour cette toux persistante.
qs.en: He should see a doctor for that persistent cough.

qs.s: Il ___ s'excuser après ce qu'il a dit hier.
qs.en: He should apologize after what he said yesterday.

qs.s: ___ partir plus tôt pour éviter les embouteillages.
qs.en: We should leave earlier to avoid traffic jams.

qs.s: ___ économiser davantage en vue de notre retraite.
qs.en: We should save more money with a view to our retirement.

qs.s: ___ prendre rendez-vous avant de venir au bureau.
qs.en: You should make an appointment before coming to the office.

qs.s: ___ réviser vos notes avant l'examen de demain.
qs.en: You should review your notes before tomorrow's exam.

qs.s: Ils ___ s'entraîner plus sérieusement s'ils veulent gagner.
qs.en: They should train more seriously if they want to win.

qs.s: Ils ___ téléphoner avant de passer à la maison.
qs.en: They should call before coming over to the house.

qs.s: Il est nécessaire ___ rendre ce rapport avant lundi.
qs.en: It is necessary that I have to submit this report before Monday.

qs.s: Le patron exige ___ rester au bureau jusqu'à la fin de la réunion.
qs.en: The boss requires that I stay at the office until the end of the meeting.

qs.s: Je suis surpris ___ partir si tôt.
qs.en: I am surprised that you have to leave so early.

qs.s: Il est dommage ___ recommencer tout depuis le début.
qs.en: It is a pity that you have to start everything over from the beginning.

qs.s: Je regrette ___ travailler le week-end.
qs.en: I regret that he has to work on the weekend.

qs.s: C'est dommage ___ annuler ses vacances.
qs.en: It is a pity that he has to cancel his holidays.

qs.s: Il est regrettable ___ payer des frais supplémentaires.
qs.en: It is regrettable that we have to pay additional fees.

qs.s: Le directeur souhaite ___ présenter nos résultats vendredi.
qs.en: The director wishes that we present our results on Friday.

qs.s: Il est normal ___ respecter le règlement intérieur.
qs.en: It is normal that you have to respect the internal regulations.

qs.s: Je suis désolé ___ attendre si longtemps.
qs.en: I am sorry that you have to wait so long.

qs.s: Il est triste ___ quitter leur pays.
qs.en: It is sad that they have to leave their country.

qs.s: Je regrette ___ travailler la nuit pour finir ce projet.
qs.en: I regret that they have to work at night to finish this project.

qs.s: Je ___ prendre le train à sept heures, sinon je serai en retard.
qs.en: I must take the seven o'clock train, otherwise I will be late.

qs.s: Tu ___ absolument aller chez le dentiste, ta douleur empire.
qs.en: You absolutely must go to the dentist, your pain is getting worse.

qs.s: Tu ___ être fatigué après une si longue journée.
qs.en: You must be tired after such a long day. (expressing supposition/should)

qs.s: Il ___ avoir oublié notre rendez-vous, car il n'est pas encore arrivé.
qs.en: He must have forgotten our appointment, since he hasn't arrived yet.

qs.s: Il ___ encore cent euros à son ami qu'il lui a empruntés.
qs.en: He still owes his friend the hundred euros he borrowed from him.

qs.s: Elle ___ trois mois de loyer à son propriétaire.
qs.en: She owes three months' rent to her landlord.

qs.s: Protéger les citoyens est le ___ premier d'un État.
qs.en: Protecting citizens is the primary duty of a state.

qs.s: Chaque citoyen a le ___ de voter lors des élections.
qs.en: Every citizen has the duty to vote in elections.

qs.s: Rembourser ses dettes est un ___ moral que l'on ne peut pas ignorer.
qs.en: Repaying one's debts is a moral obligation that one cannot ignore.

qs.s: Aider ses parents âgés est considéré comme un ___ filial dans de nombreuses cultures.
qs.en: Helping one's elderly parents is considered a filial obligation in many cultures.
